Kernel density of a point set on the lattice

Source: R/espace.R
dn_density.Rd

Bins the points on the lattice (half-open bins, right edge of the last bin closed, exactly as numpy.histogram2d), smooths with a Gaussian kernel of sp$bw_cells cells, and normalises to unit mass.

Usage

dn_density(points, sp, weights = NULL)

Arguments

points

numeric matrix (n x 2) of scores (e.g. a species' occupied cells projected into the space, or a region's cells).

sp

a dn_space.

weights

optional per-point weights (e.g. cell areas).

Value

numeric R x R matrix summing to 1 (all-zero if no point falls inside the lattice).

Examples

set.seed(1)
sp <- dn_space(cbind(rnorm(5000), rnorm(5000)), R = 60)
pts <- cbind(rnorm(300, 0.5, 0.4), rnorm(300, -0.2, 0.5))
Z <- dn_density(pts, sp)
sum(Z)                                   # unit mass
#> [1] 1
image(Z, main = "species niche density")
